tools.name: GetDebugState
tools.description: Returns the current debugger state: whether a binary is loaded, whether it is running or paused, the PID, current instruction pointer, and current module. Always available. Takes no arguments.

tools.name: ExecuteDebuggerCommand
tools.description: Executes a native x64dbg command string (like 'erun', 'analr', 'graph'). This is for x64dbg-internal commands ONLY — do NOT pass MCP tool names here. MCP tools (WaitForEvent, GetDebugState, Disassemble, etc.) must be called directly as tools.

tools.name: AttachProcess
tools.description: Attaches the debugger to a running process by PID.

tools.name: WaitForEvent
tools.description: Blocks until a debugger event fires (breakpoint hit, paused, resumed, exception, session start/stop) or timeout. Returns all events that occurred. Use this to monitor debugger state changes in real-time over HTTP — call it after 'run' or while waiting for the user to interact with the debugger.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum wait time in milliseconds (default 30000, max 120000).

tools.name: WaitForPause
tools.description: Blocks until the debuggee stops running (hits a breakpoint, exception, or exits). Returns the reason for the pause and the current address. Use after 'run' to wait for the target to break.

tools.name: run
tools.description: Resumes execution and waits for the target to pause (breakpoint, exception, or exit). Blocks until a pause event occurs or timeout. Use timeoutMs to control how long to wait (default 120s). Always returns the reason for the pause and current state.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for target to pause after resuming (default 300000ms = 5 minutes, max 600000ms = 10 minutes). The tool blocks until a breakpoint/exception fires or timeout.

tools.name: StepOut
tools.description: Runs until the current function returns to its caller (Ctrl+F9). Takes no arguments.

tools.name: PauseDebug
tools.description: Pauses (suspends) the running debuggee, equivalent to Debug > Pause (F12). Takes no arguments.

tools.name: RunToAddress
tools.description: Sets a temporary breakpoint at the target address, resumes execution, and waits for the debuggee to hit it.

tools.name: AnalyzeCode
tools.description: Runs x64dbg code analysis on a module or address range. This populates the function list, enables GetFunctions/GetReferences/DisassembleFunction. Must be run before those tools return useful results.

address.description: Address or module to analyze. If omitted, analyzes the current module.

type.description: Analysis type: 'function' (analr - analyze single function), 'module' (anal - analyze module), 'controlflow' (cfanal - control flow analysis). Default: module.
